in_marathi.name: Devji
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devji हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devji is a Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound name, consisting of the prefix 'Deva' meaning 'god' and the suffix 'ji' which is a term of respect. The name signifies the one who is the god of all gods, often referred to as Lord Shiva or Mahadev.
